summary: The WaitlistManager is a web application component for managing education program waitlists. It involves UI elements for displaying and manipulating waitlist data, handling page load and rendering events, and interacting with data through a .NET application.
purpose: The primary purpose of the WaitlistManager is to allow users to view, manage, and update the waitlist of education programs within the HSPnet web application framework.
